# One deploy of the recorder: four streams, one GPU, everything pinned so a
# rerun of the same commit measures the same thing.

name: bench-run
version: "3"

labels:
  env: lab
  gpu: a100-80g
  revision: 42

server:
  image: ghcr.io/local/llama-server:0.9
  command: >
    serve model.gguf
    --ctx-size 8192
    --parallel 4
  ports:
    - "8080:8080"
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 72Gi
      nvidia.com/gpu: 1

streams:
  - prompt: "Write a haiku about KV caches."
    max_tokens: 128
  - prompt: "Explain paged attention in two sentences."
    max_tokens: 256
  - prompt: "Name three causes of tail latency."
    max_tokens: 96
  - prompt: "Summarize the mmap vs read tradeoff."
    max_tokens: 192

output:
  dir: /var/lib/toktape
  format: tape   # gzip json, one file per run
  retention_days: 30
  overwrite: false
